pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (rendered; background pixels identical between frames, clean plate used for differencing worked with no shift)
camera.view: eye-level-ish view across a grass yard toward a timber barn; foreground tree trunk at left edge (x 0-~50) with a leafy branch across the top of the frame

perspective_cues.ground_plane: grass yard occupies y > ~1180 (barn base at y ~1183, cart wheel ground contact y ~1248); ground objects nearer the camera appear lower in the image
perspective_cues.horizon: not directly visible (hills/trees); far grass hill meets sky at y ~1110-1120 on the right (x ~1600-1920), so the horizon is near y ~1100-1150
perspective_cues.vanishing_points: barn side wall and the lean-to roof recede to the right; the barn front faces the camera almost squarely

camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from depth_info + a known size when a question gives them)

objects.name: fur_ball
objects.description: black, hairy/fuzzy soft ball (deformable, looks like a black hairball / furry ball). The only moving object.
objects.distinguishing: near-black fuzzy blob; starts lodged on the tree branch at upper left, falls and lands on the grass in the lower left foreground
objects.reference_point: mask centroid (cx, cy); for a roughly symmetric ball this approximates the object's origin/centre

apparent_size_px.on_branch_frames_0_14: bbox ~265-285 x ~192-200, equivalent-circle diameter ~218-220 (left part over dark trunk, partly behind leaves)
apparent_size_px.at_rest_frames_50_72: bbox x 230-669, y 1595-1901 (438-440 wide x 307 high), centroid (461.8, 1760.2), equivalent diameter ~331, mask major axis ~452 at ~159 deg, minor ~274 (bottom skirt may include contact shadow)
apparent_size_px.note: growth from ~220 to ~330 px equivalent diameter means the ball ends ~1.5x closer to the camera than it started (if its size were unchanged); in flight the size is unreliable because the soft body stretches (frames 44-49)

objects.name: tree_foreground
objects.description: large tree: trunk along the left image edge, leafy branch across the top; the ball starts on this branch
objects.image_extent_px: trunk x 0-~50 full height down to the ground; foliage covers y 0-~560 across the width; the branch holding the ball runs from the trunk (x~40, y~520) up-right

objects.name: barn
objects.description: timber-framed barn with gabled roof, front facing the camera, centre-left background
objects.visible_frames: 0-72 (partly occluded by the ball in frames ~38-45)

objects.name: barn_door
objects.description: dark open doorway in barn front (with an open wooden door leaf to its left)

objects.name: barrels
objects.description: two wooden barrels side by side at barn front right of the doorway

objects.name: flower_bush
objects.description: small white/pink flower bush at barn front left corner

objects.name: cart
objects.description: wooden hand cart / wagon with a large spoked wheel, right side, tilted with shafts on the ground

objects.name: fence
objects.description: short wooden rail fence behind the cart

objects.name: barn_side_ladder_steps
objects.description: wooden steps/ladder leaning at the barn's right side

objects.name: sunlit_ground_patches_and_shadows
objects.description: yellow sunlit grass patches and tree shadows on the yard (lighting only, not objects)

events.event: ball sagging slowly on the branch (centroid drifts down ~6 px over frames 0-14)
ball leaves the branch / clear fall begins (downward pixel speed rises above ~2-4 px/frame); not a sharp event
ball clears the branch, fully below it
ball passes in front of barn (left part)
ball hits the ground (first contact, strongly squashed/stretched in frame 49)
ball at rest on the grass (no bounce); tiny settling changes at frames 60 and 64 (<1 px in centroid)
end of video, ball still at rest
